You can send a written legal notice to the cheque drawer within 30 days of getting the bank’s return memo [CHEQUE-138]. The drawer then has 15 days from receiving the notice to pay the Rs 1.5 lakh [CHEQUE-138]. If the amount is still unpaid, you may file a criminal complaint within one month after those 15 days end [CHEQUE-138]. Do you have the drawer’s current address? Have you kept a copy of the cheque and the bank’s return memo? Have you communicated with the drawer after the bounce?

🧑‍⚖️ This looks like something where a real lawyer (or the District Legal Services Authority, free legal aid helpline 15100) should be involved before you act. I can still help you organise your facts and documents to take to them.
